title: The King Saves the People
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks closely and speaks up, and tonight Esther finally tells the king the hard truth that saves her people: Scout sees a smaller child blamed for a tower that fell by accident and says plainly that it was only a bump.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout is honest and speaks up. In Scout’s world today: Scout saw a smaller child’s tower get knocked down by accident, and the child was blamed. Scout spoke up: “It was a bump — nobody meant to.” Telling the truth made everything fair again. Just like brave Esther told the truth to save her people, Scout learned that honest words can protect and help others.
